title: Supervision-Adaptive Curriculum and Guarded Anti-Curriculum Learning for Dense Prediction
abstract: arXiv:2610.29519v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Curriculum learning orders samples by difficulty, but difficulty alone does not establish supervision reliability for dense prediction. Easy samples can expose shortcuts, hard samples can be informative, and noisy or ambiguous samples can mislead training. Building on our conference method CurriSeg, we present PaceShift, a stabilize-then-challenge paradigm combining supervision-adaptive curriculum selection with guarded spectral post-training. A learning-dynamics view motivates separating supervision reliability from temporal update value and applying spectral challenges after stabilization. The first phase estimates reliability from available supervision, augmentation consistency, model disagreement, and prediction certainty. Temporal statistics guide sample weighting, while pixel-uncertainty weights reduce the early influence of uncertain regions. The second phase ranks predictions from multiple spectral views using supervision agree

translated_title: 面向密集预测的监督自适应课程学习与受保护反课程学习
translated_abstract: 课程学习按难度对样本进行排序，但仅凭难度并不能确立密集预测任务中监督信息的可靠性。简单样本可能暴露学习捷径，困难样本可能富有信息量，而噪声或模糊样本则可能误导训练。基于我们的会议论文方法 CurriSeg，我们提出了 PaceShift，这是一种“先稳定、后挑战”的范式，将监督自适应的课程选择与受保护的谱后训练相结合。基于学习动力学的视角，我们将监督可靠性与时间更新价值分离开来，并在模型稳定之后再施加谱域挑战。第一阶段从可用的监督信号、数据增广一致性、模型分歧和预测确定性来估计可靠性；时间统计量用于指导样本加权，同时像素级不确定性权重可降低不确定区域在训练早期的影响。第二阶段利用监督一致性对来自多个谱视角的预测进行排序（摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: 提出 PaceShift 方法，采用“先稳定、后挑战”的范式，将监督自适应课程选择与受保护的谱后训练相结合，通过区分监督可靠性与时间更新价值来提升密集预测的训练效果。
en_tdlr: PaceShift introduces a stabilize-then-challenge paradigm that combines supervision-adaptive curriculum selection with guarded spectral post-training, separating supervision reliability from temporal update value to improve dense prediction.
